title: Taking a Stored Vehicle Off the Road? Turn In / Deactivate Registration Plates BEFORE Canceling Liability Insurance!

no_head_on_same_lane.note: All visible vehicles in lower road view travel same direction in right lane; no head-on facing in same lane.

no_rhd_cabin.note: Lower panel shows left-hand-drive cabin with steering wheel on left in front of driver; no right-side wheel.

single_bulb_signal.note: Center background signal shows only single green lens lit, other lenses dark.

us_right_hand_traffic.note: Lower road view shows yellow centerline on left of travel lane and white edge line/curb on right, vehicles on right side.

zero_text.note: Plates, monitors, framed art, folder with umbrella icon appear as blank shapes/icons; no readable letters or numbers visible.

scene_match.note: Shows Step 1 plate surrender at DMV counter on top and Step 2 umbrella insurance folder in lower panel, matching two-step sequence.

result.summary: All visual rules pass and sequence is depicted, but Step 2 is shown as handling a folder while in the driver's seat of a car in traffic, which models distracted driving.

teaching_correct.note: Order plates-then-insurance is correct, but depicting closing/handling the insurance folder while actively driving teaches unsafe behavior and confuses stored-vehicle context.

result.what_i_see: Two-panel graphic: top a woman hands two blank plates across a DMV counter to a clerk; bottom the same woman in the driver seat holds a blue umbrella folder while stopped/in traffic on a tree-lined US road under a green light.
